title: Why quantum computing will break cryptocurrency by 2030

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know quantum computers could crack encryption in minutes?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Cryptocurrencies rely on math that’s impossible to break… for now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Quantum computing uses qubits to solve problems no classical computer can.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: By 2030, quantum algorithms like Shor’s could break RSA encryption used in Bitcoin.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This would let hackers steal private keys and drain wallets in seconds.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Crypto needs quantum-resistant updates — and time is running out.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Follow me to stay ahead of the tech curve — what’s next after quantum computing?

caption_text: Why quantum computing will break cryptocurrency by 2030
